I reviewed all of lines 1–94 using the supplied text and did not open any other files. The file has six short theorems. The first three are surjectivity facts about composition, isomorphisms and base change. The base-change proof is a single tensor induction, with no counterpart elsewhere in the file. The other three theorems are about localization.

The only overlap I found is between `surjective_localizationPreserves` and `surjective_ofLocalizationSpan`. Both call `IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq` and then `IsLocalization.map_mk'`, which are existing API calls. Everything else in the two proofs differs. The first lifts a fraction through `f`. The second goes through `Submodule.mem_of_span_eq_top_of_smul_pow_mem` and clears denominators with `eq_iff_exists`, `mul_comm` and `pow_add`. This overlap is routine unfolding, not repeated nontrivial reasoning, so a shared lemma would not help.

`surjective_localRingHom_of_surjective` is a thin wrapper around `surjective_localizationPreserves`. I did not read the definitions of the surrounding library, so I cannot rule out a duplicate elsewhere. Within this file I found no repeated proof machinery worth extracting.
